transcript: Speaker A: नमस्कार! एक बड़ी खबर है। अब English सीखना मुश्किल नहीं रहा। एक ऐसा app आ चुका है। नाम है SpeakEasy App. इस app में आपको छोटे-छोटे lessons मिलते हैं जहां experts simple Hindi में समझाते हैं। क्या बोलना है, कैसे बोलना है, step by step सिखाया जाता है। और सबसे खास feature - AI teacher. 24 घंटे available! आप जो सीखते हो उसी समय practice कर सकते हो। गलत बोलो तुरंत सुधार मिलता है। 100 बार गलती करो, 100 बार सही कराया जाता है। ना डांट, ना judgement, बस सीखने का सही माहौल। बहुत लोगों ने सिर्फ 10-15 मिनट रोज practice करके अपनी English improve की है। तो अगर आपको भी आसान तरीके से English सीखनी है, आज ही शुरू करो। [Hello! There is big news. Now learning English is no longer difficult. An app has arrived called SpeakEasy App. In this app, you get short lessons explained by experts in simple Hindi. What to speak, how to speak, is taught step by step. And the most special feature - AI teacher, available 24 hours! You can practice what you learn immediately. Speak wrong, get corrected instantly. Make mistakes 100 times, get corrected 100 times. No scolding, no judgment, just the right learning environment. Many have improved their English by practicing just 10-15 minutes daily. So if you also want to learn English easily, start today.] Speaker B: अभी SpeakEasy app डाउनलोड करें और फर्राटेदार इंग्लिश बोलना शुरू करें। [Download the SpeakEasy app now and start speaking fluent English.]

summary: An AI news anchor presents the SpeakEasy App as a solution for learning English through bite-sized lessons explained in Hindi. The ad highlights the 24/7 AI teacher feature that offers instant, judgment-free pronunciation corrections. It concludes with a call to action to download the app for fluent English speaking.
